Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: nanoscan3-manual, p. 63

CONFIGURATION 8 For certain actions (e.g., transferring a configuration to the device), you are requested to log onto the device with the respective user group. Important information NOTICE When you log into a device, the configuration software stores the password so that you do not need to re-enter it for other configuration steps. If you do not change any other settings in the login dialog, the password is deleted as soon as you exit the configuration software, or log out in the main window or Device window. If you enable the Temporarily store password for login on additional devices. func- tion, the password will be retained even if you log out in the device window only. If you leave the computer unattended, you must log off to prevent unwanted access to the device.
